description: Add a custom field to a project, e.g. Price (money, UAH), Hours (number), Platform (select), Client contact (text). Types: text, number, money (an amount in the field's currency; values are plain numbers, "12 000,50" is read too), date, select (one option), multi (several options), url, person (a member), checkbox, payments (the parts of the payment of one issue, e.g. 50 % in advance received + 50 % on delivery expected; value = [{amount, currency?, date?, paid, note?}] in the currency of the field), formula (computed by the server from the other fields and the issue, read-only in issues; give `formula`, and `currency` to show the result as money). FORMULA language: fields by name in curly braces {Price}; numbers, "text", true/false; + - * / % (date + days, date - date = days), & joins text; = != < <= > >=; and, or, not; functions if(c,a,b), ifs(c1,v1,...,else), empty(x), round(x,n), floor, ceil, abs, min, max, sum, concat, length, lower, upper, contains(text,part), text(x), number(x), today(), date("YYYY-MM-DD") or date(y,m,d), days_between(a,b) (= b - a in days), add_days(d,n), year, month, day, convert(amount, "UAH", "USD", date?) and rate("USD", date?) by the National Bank of Ukraine rate of that day; a payments field alone = what was received, expected(p), payments_total(p), last_payment(p), next_payment(p); issue properties title, status, status_kind, is_done, is_closed, priority, assignee, due_date, start_date, created, updated, labels, client, milestone. Empty numbers count as 0 in arithmetic. Example: if({Paid} >= {Price}, "Paid", if({Pay by} < today(), "Overdue", "Waiting")).

currency.description: the currency of a money field (default USD), or of a formula field whose result is an amount

formula.description: the formula of a formula field, e.g. {Price} - {Paid}

on_card.description: show the value on the board cards

options.description: the choices of a select / multi field

type.description: field type, e.g. money for a price, number for hours, select for one choice from options

name: create_field
